subject: Inaugural Meeting and Climate Action Plan
overview: The Medford Climate Equity Council held its inaugural meeting to introduce members, review the council's advisory purpose, and examine the city's Climate Action and Adaptation Plan. Members discussed upcoming initiatives, including the Electrify Medford outreach campaign, and identified priorities such as program affordability, flood vulnerability, and alternative transportation for future meetings.

items.title: Introductions and Council Purpose
items.summary: Staff and community liaisons introduced themselves and explained that the newly formed council will represent historically underrepresented communities to advise on the city's Climate Action and Adaptation Plan.

items.title: Climate Action and Adaptation Plan Overview
items.summary: Staff summarized the city's climate plan, highlighting emissions reduction targets in buildings and transportation along with municipal decarbonization and infrastructure initiatives.

items.title: Ongoing City Climate Initiatives
items.summary: Staff detailed near-term projects including expanding municipal EV charging stations, building weatherization, and rooftop solar installations, while council members stressed that programs must address public transit, bicycle access, and municipal leading-by-example.

items.title: Electrify Medford Outreach Campaign
items.summary: Staff presented plans for the upcoming Electrify Medford campaign, which aims to recruit community energy coaches and provide targeted incentives and technical assistance to help lower-income residents and renters adopt clean energy.

items.title: Council Feedback and Future Agenda Topics
items.summary: Council members discussed flood risk projections, electric heating safety, and upfront cost barriers, requesting future presentations focused on affordability, Mass Save incentives, flood maps, and emergency shelter plans.

items.title: Next Meeting and Administration
items.summary: The council agreed to hold its next meeting virtually on December 18, 2023, where members will discuss selecting a council chair.
